decisions.reason: As a newly launched flagship tied to the firm's stated strategic direction, management is very likely to continue backing it rather than quickly admit failure or write off the commitment.
This foldable large container is a multi-model line with visible website commitment, so the firm has enough investment and public attachment to persist with it.
Although it had less prominent website exposure, it is still a new multi-model crate line in the firm's core reusable-packaging business, which favors continuation.
The rackable pallet fits the established product portfolio and likely required meaningful development effort, making management more inclined to give it more time than to withdraw it quickly.
This spill-retention pallet line had dedicated website presentation and sits close to the firm's existing capabilities, so escalation of commitment points to retaining it.
Despite being a single product rather than a broader line, it received standalone promotion and matches the firm's pallet offering, which still makes near-term withdrawal unlikely.
